submission.justification: F1 at 4 mm gives the best simulated resolution at 100 GeV, 3.327%. F3 at 5 mm is the next best at 3.886%, and F2 is worst at about 5.08%. The hard dose constraint (20 uSv/h at 1 m after one week) could NOT be verified for any material. No dose data was available, and the dose estimates are -1 sentinels. F1 is therefore recommended on resolution alone and is conditional on a dose check. If F1 fails that check, fall back to F3 at 5 mm (3.886%), which has not been dose-verified either. The dose check should be done before this design is committed.

requirements.requirement: Best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV
requirements.evidence: F1 at 4 mm gives 3.327%, the lowest of all materials and thicknesses scanned (2-10 mm).

requirements.requirement: Residual dose rate at 1 m after 1 week <= 20 uSv/h (hard)
requirements.evidence: dose_data_available=0, dose estimates are -1 for F1/F2/F3, dose_compliance_verified=0. Compliance cannot be confirmed.

requirements.requirement: Absorber is one of the three candidate materials
